params.body:
## Summary
- Fixes the "Publiceren op portalen" switch (added in #415) rendering with a square left edge and an overlapping knob on the own-stock row.
- Root cause: `#cars_table input[type=checkbox]` (the row-selection checkbox styling) is an ID selector, which outranks the single-class `.ui-switch-input` rule that hides the native checkbox (`opacity: 0; width: 0; height: 0;`). The switch's `<input type="checkbox">` lives inside `#cars_table` too, so it inherited `opacity: .85; width: 15px; height: 15px;` from that rule and rendered as a visible native checkbox layered on top of the custom `.ui-switch-track` pill.
- Scoped the row-selection rule with `:not(.ui-switch-input)` so it only targets the actual selection checkboxes; the switch's input stays hidden and only the drawn track/knob show, matching the settings-page `ui-toggle-row` switch.

## Test plan
- [x] `vendor/bin/phpunit --filter "OwnStockRowMarkup|StylesheetSyntax|AlpineExpression"` — 17 tests, 794 assertions, green.
- [x] `vendor/bin/phpunit --filter "RulesCoverage|RulesIdentity"` — 7 tests, 12 assertions, green.
- [x] Rendered the row directly (`view('ownstock._wagen_rij', ...)`) with a dealer that has the portal link, wrapped it in the real theme CSS, and screenshotted the open portals panel at 1440 and 390 before/after the fix (switch on and off). The track is now a clean rounded pill on both ends with the knob fully inside it, matching the settings switch.
params.title: The publish switch looks like every other switch
